title: A clearer programming curriculum library
summary: Redesign the curriculum screen with a scrollable introduction, readable phase filters and less cluttered topic cards.

changes.detail: Moved the introduction and search into the topic list so the entire screen scrolls together; added clearer localized headings and a prominent library link.
Replaced clipped horizontal phase chips with an expandable full-label phase picker and explicit All topics / Available now controls.
Replaced mixed Arabic slash counters with complete localized completion phrases and clarified unpublished topic status.
Added phase-specific icons and green, amber and violet categories; show progress bars only after at least one completed lesson.
Added empty-result filter reset and an interaction regression test for combined filters, search reset, Arabic labels and navigation.
Removed repetitive empty 0% progress bars and the redundant numbered metadata from topic cards.

validation.name: Automated validation
validation.detail: Typecheck, focused lint, curriculum interaction and history tests pending.

validation.name: Visual review
validation.detail: UI inventory reports no available browser or native app; rendered mobile and native-device appearance remain unverified. No deployment.
